serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Once again, thanks for your help~
You: Don’t worry about it, but are you sure? You are giving it back pretty quickly, I don’t want you to struggle without a reason.
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: I will be fine, you worry too much! 
Lady Annalie: If you insist, instead of cash I can give you coupons to my shop! 
#Annalie.face.shocked
You: Ah, no. Cash will be fine.
Lady Annalie: Unsuspected rejection?!
#Annalie.face.sad
Lady Annalie: And here I thought I had you wrapped around my little finger…
#Annalie.face.normal
You: That’s what you get for all that teasing.
Lady Annalie: Yes, yes, I know~
Lady Annalie: Anyway, take a look at my new merchandise…
